description: This file contains the implementation of DatabaseConfigProvider class which resolves the application's PostgreSQL connection string from configuration sources, including environment variables and configuration files. It also defines the DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult record to convey the outcome of connection string resolution.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigProvider
classes.description: Provides functionality to resolve the database connection string from configuration sources and environment variables.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult
classes.description: Represents the result of attempting to resolve the database connection string, including success, failure, and error details.

methods.name: DatabaseConfigProvider.IConfiguration
methods.description: Injected dependency for accessing application's configuration data.

methods.name: TryResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and validate the PostgreSQL connection string from configuration or environment variables.

methods.name: DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult.Configured
methods.description: Factory method to create a successful resolution result with a given connection string.

methods.name: DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult.NotConfigured
methods.description: Factory method to create a result indicating the connection string was not configured.

methods.name: DatabaseConnectionResolutionResult.Error
methods.description: Factory method to create a result indicating an error occurred during resolution, with an error message.
